step.name: Step 1: Define Requirements & Vision — This is where we sit down and get to know your dreams for the space. We’ll discuss your requirements, project scope, budget, and desired schedule. This phase is all about listening to your needs and understanding your lifestyle, ensuring we’re aligned from the very beginning.
step.text: Step 1: Define Requirements & Vision — This is where we sit down and get to know your dreams for the space. We’ll discuss your requirements, project scope, budget, and desired schedule. This phase is all about listening to your needs and understanding your lifestyle, ensuring we’re aligned from the very beginning.

step.name: Step 2: Select Design-Builder & Develop Initial Design — Once you've chosen LineWork Development as your partner, our team collaborates with you on the initial design concepts. We'll present preliminary drawings and ideas, working together to refine them until they truly reflect your vision, always keeping functionality and aesthetics balanced.
step.text: Step 2: Select Design-Builder & Develop Initial Design — Once you've chosen LineWork Development as your partner, our team collaborates with you on the initial design concepts. We'll present preliminary drawings and ideas, working together to refine them until they truly reflect your vision, always keeping functionality and aesthetics balanced.

step.name: Step 3: Align Design, Cost, & Schedule — Before moving forward, we ensure that the evolving design, the project cost, and the construction schedule are all perfectly aligned. This iterative process prevents budget surprises later on and ensures the design is buildable within your financial and time constraints.
step.text: Step 3: Align Design, Cost, & Schedule — Before moving forward, we ensure that the evolving design, the project cost, and the construction schedule are all perfectly aligned. This iterative process prevents budget surprises later on and ensures the design is buildable within your financial and time constraints.

step.name: Step 4: Execute Design-Build Contract & Detailed Design — With the preliminary design and budget agreed upon, we finalize the design-build contract. Then, our team dives into creating detailed architectural drawings and structural calculations, securing all necessary permits and approvals from local authorities.
step.text: Step 4: Execute Design-Build Contract & Detailed Design — With the preliminary design and budget agreed upon, we finalize the design-build contract. step.name: Step 5: Construction & Project Management — This is where the magic happens! Our skilled craftsmen and project managers take over, bringing the detailed design to life. We manage all aspects of construction, from coordinating trades to overseeing quality control, keeping you informed every step of the way with transparent communication and digital updates.

step.name: Step 6: Inspections, Commissioning, & Closeout — As construction nears completion, we coordinate all necessary inspections, ensuring everything meets code and our high-quality standards. We’ll walk through the finished project with you, address any final details, and hand over your beautifully transformed home, ready for you to enjoy.
step.text: Ready to transform your home with a unified team? Contact LineWork Development today to start your design-build journey.
